# Homerun Fabrication

> Custom steel buildings, barndominiums, metal fabrication, and agricultural structures in Amarillo, TX. Founded by Corey Homer in 2008. Serving an 80-mile radius across the Texas Panhandle.

## Company

Homerun Fabrication is a metal fabrication and ground-up construction company based in Amarillo, Texas. Founded in 2008 by owner Corey Homer, the company has built hundreds of steel structures, barndominiums, agricultural facilities, and finished living spaces across the Texas Panhandle. The crew handles every phase of construction in-house — from concrete pads and steel erection through wood framing, exterior enclosure, and full interior finishing including kitchens, bathrooms, and custom living areas. One contractor, one timeline, one accountable team from foundation to final walkthrough.

- Owner / Founder: Corey Homer
- Founded: 2008
- Headquarters: 18771 19th Street, Amarillo, TX 79124
- Phone: (806) 671-7930
- Email: coreyhomer@att.net

## Service Area Cities

Amarillo, Canyon, Hereford, Borger, Pampa, Dumas, Tulia, Claude, Vega, Bushland, Wildorado, and the surrounding rural communities and ranches throughout the Texas Panhandle.

## Services

### Steel Buildings
URL: https://homerunfabrication.com/services/steel-buildings
Engineered steel building construction including shops, barns, agricultural storage, and commercial structures. Red-iron framing, metal siding, rollup doors, and concrete pads built to 115–120 mph wind loads for Texas Panhandle conditions. Sizes from 30x40 shops up through commercial spans exceeding 10,000 square feet.

### Barndominiums
URL: https://homerunfabrication.com/services/barndominiums
Custom barndominium construction from steel erection through fully finished interiors. Single-story, two-story, and shop-with-living-quarters builds. Complete in-house finish-out including custom kitchens with quartz countertops, full bathrooms with tile showers, stacked stone fireplaces, wood beam ceilings, LVP flooring, and trim. Typical builds run $150–$225 per finished square foot turnkey.

### Custom Fabrication
URL: https://homerunfabrication.com/services/custom-fabrication
MIG and stick welding, structural steel components, custom brackets, repair welding, and one-off metalwork built in our Amarillo shop. Mild steel and structural steel including A36 plate, square and rectangular tubing, channel, angle, pipe, and red-iron sections.

### Pipe Fencing
URL: https://homerunfabrication.com/services/pipe-fencing
Welded pipe fencing, cattle pens, alley chutes, working facilities, loading ramps, gates, and corral systems. Heavy-duty oilfield pipe construction (2-3/8", 2-7/8", 4-1/2"+) welded in place — not bolt-together. Built for serious West Texas livestock operations.

### Prototyping
URL: https://homerunfabrication.com/services/prototyping
Single-unit and small-batch metal prototype fabrication for inventors, engineers, and operators refining a design before production. NDAs welcome. Most prototypes turn around in 1–3 weeks.

### Industrial Design
URL: https://homerunfabrication.com/services/industrial-design
Engineered structural steel solutions for ag, oilfield, and commercial customers. Load-bearing assemblies, equipment supports, structural frameworks, mezzanines, conveyor framing. Coordination with engineering partners for stamped drawings when required.

### Manufacturing & Assembly
URL: https://homerunfabrication.com/services/manufacturing-assembly
Production-run fabrication and contract assembly services. Repeat batch runs of steel components and weldments, pre-production pilots, and recurring orders. Capacity to scale from prototype through production in the same shop.

## FAQs

Q: How much does a barndominium cost in the Texas Panhandle?
A: Finished barndominiums in the Amarillo area generally run $150 to $225 per square foot turnkey. A 2,000 sq ft single-story finished build typically lands between $300,000 and $450,000.

Q: How much does a steel building cost in Amarillo, TX?
A: A turnkey 30x40 steel shop typically runs $45,000 to $75,000. Larger commercial spans push higher based on engineering loads, finish-out, and site prep.

Q: How long does a barndominium take to build?
A: Most single-story barndominium builds run 5 to 7 months from concrete pour to finished walkthrough. Two-story builds and larger custom finish packages typically run 7 to 10 months.

Q: What wind load do you build steel buildings for in the Texas Panhandle?
A: Steel buildings are engineered to meet or exceed 115 to 120 mph wind load requirements, with bracing, anchor bolts, and gauge thickness specified for the exposure category of each site.

Q: Do you handle the full build or just the steel work?
A: Homerun Fabrication handles the complete build from the ground up — site prep, steel erection, wood framing, exterior siding and roofing, ZIP System sheathing, windows and doors, insulation, and full interior finishing.

Q: What size pipe do you use for cattle fencing?
A: Cattle pens use 2-3/8" and 2-7/8" oilfield pipe for rails, with 4-1/2"+ pipe for posts on heavy-use corners and gates.

Q: What areas around Amarillo do you serve?
A: An 80-mile radius from Amarillo, covering Canyon, Hereford, Borger, Pampa, Dumas, Tulia, Claude, Vega, Bushland, Wildorado, and the surrounding rural communities.

Q: How do I get started on a custom project?
A: Call (806) 671-7930 or send a message through the contact form at https://homerunfabrication.com/contact. We'll set up a site walk and provide a written quote with a build timeline.
